page.overview:
What is Darkfire?

The Darkfire was the name of the starship captained by Flandon Sweeg in Rogar Farnoster's The Slug Named Grendel.

The work the Darkfire appeared in bears strong similarities with the 1851 novel [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moby_Dick Moby Dick], authored by [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Herman_Melville Herman Melville]. Such similarities includes the formatting of the first line and the narrative of the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ishmael_(Moby-Dick) protagonist] who has joined a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pequod_(Moby-Dick) crew] upon a quest led by a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Captain_Ahab captain] of questionable morals after a sizable limbless, ship-destroying [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moby_Dick_(whale) creature] colored white.
